summary.note: computed from the per-instance phase files: counts and seconds of the invocation that computed each instance (a resumed run keeps the original instances' costs; shared per-start samples computed by a killed invocation and reused are in no phase file); engine replays are disk-cache misses

full_checkpoint.assumption: economy verdict rows charged 125 per pool to every instance whose (start, forced events) group has no 1,000-row verdict prefix (an upper bound: kept rows already inside a shorter prefix are not sampled again); instances in a group with a cross-checked member need none

basis.cem_counts: measured on this run's instances; flip floor's upper bound

engine_cache.note: the size difference includes whatever other processes wrote meanwhile
